name: The Red Gill (station 7; biomes/gills/PLAN.md section 11 item 1): the Reḍ Gīl on the Godthrone's south flank at 5.4 km, one great radial crack 1.6 km long, 60 m across and 300 m deep, its lips lined with tall red pipes, rust collars and dark fringes, the breath meadow downwind over red-stained ice, the ice belt's cliff and the bloodfalls on the skyline; set in spring at the out-breath
